_note: The goalkeeper's positioning (OI-81-step-move, ADR-045, cantiere 2026-11-11 second). POSITIONING_RANGE_CM: beyond this distance from the ball to the goal line, the keeper stays on the line at the goal centre (t = 0). ADVANCE_CM: how far the keeper advances off his line when the ball is on the goal line (t = 1). The target is on the ball-goal segment: y_target = goal_y + (ball_y - goal_y) * t, x_target = goal_line +/- ADVANCE_CM * t, with t = clamp(1 - d_ball_goal / POSITIONING_RANGE_CM, 0, 1). The keeper moves with resolve_movement, like every other agent: the same formula, a different target. No die. At L0 the positioning is geometric (the ball and the goal); the shooter's body enters with the read in flight (OI-81-step-c). Support (2026-11-12, maintainer: the keeper steps up and is an outlet when his side has the ball): with the ball, the keeper follows his defensive line at support_gap_cm behind it, never farther than support_max_cm from his goal line; he is then a teammate the carrier can pass back to. Without the ball the rule above applies. depth_share_milli (2026-11-12, ADR-051): without the ball the keeper is never deeper than this share of the ball's distance from his goal line, so he is always between the ball and the goal; before, with the ball close to the line at a side he advanced 4 m and stood behind the shooter, who scored from beside the post.
_source: Declared, arbitrary until L3: the form is geometry (the keeper covers the post, the keeper advances when the ball is close), the numbers are a prototype. Calibrate against real goalkeeper positioning distributions (distance from the line as a function of the ball distance). No cited figure for the two values. support_gap_cm 2500 and support_max_cm 2200: order of magnitude of a modern keeper's position when his side attacks (15-25 m off the line); arbitrary until L3.
